svg.aria-label: Shift Roster: a fair staff roster in a minute. Animation: a fictional ward roster made by hand breaks 140 rules (single days off, single working days) and leaves 28 shifts short; Shift Roster's roster breaks none, leaves 11 short and grants 20 of 25 requests.
svg.title: Shift Roster
svg.text: HOSPITALS · CARE HOMES · FACTORIES · CALL CENTRES
A fair staff roster in a minute: every rule kept
(rest between shifts, hours, runs of days, weekends,
leave), as many requests granted as possible, and
the cover the ward needs. Repaired in seconds when
